LoKI-MC-formatted electron-impact cross sections for Neon
Source: Biagi database (transcription of data from SF Biagi's Fortran code, Magboltz v8.9), www.lxcat.net/Biagi
Extracted from new_Ne_LXcat.txt (LXCat download) and reformatted on 2026-07-14.

NOTE (2026-07-14): This file replaces the previous BSR set, whose elastic momentum-transfer
table ended at 200-300 eV and made LoKI-MC abort once any electron outran the table
(BoltzmannMC.C hard error). The Biagi set is a complete, swarm-derived set: real elastic
momentum transfer (not an Effective sum), 45 level-resolved excitation channels and
ionization, all tabulated up to ~1 keV, so swarm calculations are valid well past 300 Td /
300 eV. Collision descriptions are one-way, so no superelastics and no statisticalWeight
entries are required in the setup files: population Ne(1S0) = 1 is enough.
The original BSR file is kept as Ne_LXCat_BSR_backup.txt; the raw two-database download
(Biagi + Phelps) is kept at LoKI-MC/new_Ne_LXcat.txt.
The Phelps alternative was rejected: its momentum-transfer entry is an EFFECTIVE cross
section (needs an error-prone unfolding into elastic, cf. the F2 negative-value warning in
errorLog.txt) and its tables end at 200-300 eV, which reproduces the original failure.
